死亡守望剑术大师老兵
3 6" 3+ 15
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
特种爆矢手枪 4 3+ 3/4 范围 8"、穿刺 1
异形相位剑（决斗） 5 3+ 4/6 残暴、致命 5+
异形相位剑（相位横扫） 4 3+ 4/6 残暴、致命 5、相位横扫*
适应性剑术：您可以忽略任何对这名特工异形相位
剑命中属性的修正。每当这名特工进行近战或反击
时，您可以在正常流程之前结算一个己方成功。若
此，那次成功必须为格挡。
*相位横扫：每当这名特工使用这个武器执行近战行
动时，若它没有残废，则它可以在之后立即执行一
个无消耗近战行动，但您必须为此选择这个武器，
并且只能在每次激活或反击中对每一名处于控制范
围内的敌方特工使用这个武器进行一次近战。本规
则优先于行动限制，并且您可以持续执行无消耗的
近战行动，直至这名特工残废或已经对每个它控制
范围内的敌方特工进行了近战。
死亡守望、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、剑术大师 32

3 6" 3+ 15
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR

Xenophase blade (duel) 5 3+ 4/6 Brutal, Lethal 5+

Adaptive Swordsmanship: You can ignore any changes to the Hit
stat of this operative’s xenophase blade. Whenever this operative
is fighting or retaliating, you can resolve one of your successes
before the normal order. If you do, that success must be used
to block.
*Phase Sweep: Whenever this operative performs the Fight
action with this weapon profile, if it isn't incapacitated, it can
immediately perform a free Fight action afterwards, but you
must select this weapon profile and it can only fight against each
enemy operative within its control range once per activation or
counteraction using this weapon profile. This takes precedence
over action restrictions, and you can continue to perform free
Fight actions until this operative is incapacitated or has fought
against every enemy operative within its control range.
DEATHWATCH , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, BLADEMASTER 32

先进全相干扰器：战略计划。选择对这名特工可见
且位于其 6" 内的一名敌方特工，随后掷一枚 D6。
在该转折点的交战阶段中，那名敌方战士直到下列
条件之一达成前无法被激活或执行行动：
• 您的对手激活了数量等同于 D6 掷骰结果数量的
敌方特工。
• 那名敌方特工是最后一名被激活的敌方特工。
鸟卜仪三角定位：在下列条件均满足的情况下，您
可以消耗 0CP 使用“先进鸟卜扫描” 交战计谋：
• 这名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内。
• 那次射击行动的目标（此处特指主要目标，如果
有）对这名特工可见。
请注意，这不意味着必须是这名特工执行射击行
动，并且任何在那次激活/反应期间执行的射击行动
都必须满足同样的条件（否则那个计谋不会对之后
的射击行动产生任何效果)。
死亡守望、帝国、阿斯塔特修会、干扰者 32

3 7" 3+ 13
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Marksman bolt carbine 4 3+ 3/4 Lethal 5+

Advanced Omni-Scrambler: STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select
one enemy operative visible to or within 6" of this operative,
then roll one D6. In the Firefight phase of this turning point, that
enemy operative cannot be activated or perform actions until one
of the following is true:
• Your opponent has activated a number of enemy operatives
equal to the result of the D6.
• It’s the last enemy operative to be activated.
Auspex Triangulation: The Advanced Auspex Scan firefight ploy
costs you 0CP when both of the following are true:
• This operative isn’t within control range of enemy operatives.
• The target of that Shoot action (primary target, if relevant) is
visible to this operative.
Note that it doesn’t have to be this operative performing
the Shoot action, and that any subsequent Shoot actions
during that activation/counteraction must meet these same
requirements (or that ploy has no effect on those subsequent
Shoot actions).
DEATHWATCH , IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS ASTARTES, DISRUPTOR 32

cards.image: 10-01-小队选择-死亡守望杀戮小队.png
cards.text:
死亡守望
杀戮小队
原型：搜索与摧毁，安全保护
特工
↘ 5 名死亡守望特工，从以下列表进行选择:
• 守望军士
• 庇护者
• 剑术大师
• 轰击手
• 突破手
• 粉碎者
• 干扰者
• 炮手
• 夺首者
• 兽群屠戮者
• 神射手
上述的每一名特工只能被纳入您的杀戮小队一次。
同时。您的杀戮小队至多能被纳入一名重装型装
甲特工。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: SEEK & DESTROY, SECURITY
OPERATIVES
↘ 5 DEATHWATCH operatives selected from
the following list:
• WATCH SERGEANT
• AEGIS
• BLADEMASTER
• BOMBARD
• BREACHER
• DEMOLISHER
• DISRUPTOR
• GUNNER
• HEADTAKER
• HORDE-SLAYER
• MARKSMAN
Your kill team can only include each operative
on this list once, and can only include up to one
GRAVIS operative.

cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营规则
阿斯塔特老兵
这些经过基因改造的超级战士们生来便是为了
无尽的战争而准备的。他们的技艺在漫长的战
斗岁月中得到磨砺，并在漫长警戒中通过专业
学识进一步得到增强。
在每一名己方死亡守望特工激活时，他可以执
行两次射击行动或两次近战行动。如果选择执行
两次射击行动，若在两次行动中都使用了下挂榴
弹发射器、破片炮、重型等离子焚化枪、地狱火
重型爆矢枪、等离子手枪或追猎者爆矢步枪，或
为任一行动选择了热熔炸弹，在第二次行动时便
需要额外消耗 1 AP。
每一名己方死亡守望特工可以进行反应，无论
其拥有的命令。若此，它便可以在那次反击中无
消耗额外执行一次 1 AP 的行动，但两次行动必
须是不同的，并且在同一个反击中您不能选择一
次近战和一次射击行动。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION RULE
VETERAN ASTARTES
These genetically modified superhumans are made to
wage unending war. Their skills have been honed over
long years of battle and further refined with specialist
knowledge through their Long Vigil.
During each friendly DEATHWATCH operative’s
activation, it can perform either two Shoot
actions or two Fight actions. If it’s two Shoot
actions and an auxiliary grenade launcher, frag
cannon, heavy plasma incinerator, infernus
heavy bolter, plasma pistol or stalker bolt rifle is
selected for both, or if a melta bomb is selected
for either, 1 additional AP must be spent for the
second action.
Each friendly DEATHWATCH operative can
counteract regardless of its order. Whenever it
does, it can perform an additional 1AP action for
free during that counteraction, but both actions
must be different and you cannot perform a Fight
and Shoot action during the same counteraction.

cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营规则
特制弹药
死亡守望的多种武器使用了各种特制弹药。每
种弹药都为消灭特定异形而设计。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方死亡守望特工
执行射击行动时，在选择武器步骤时，您可以使
用这个规则。若此，您可以为那名特工的远程
武器在那次行动结束前选择下列武器规则。这
个规则无法用于爆炸手雷（见通用装备）或热熔
炸弹。
• 爆炸 1"（如果您使用的武器拥有“洪流”武器
规则，便无法选择本选项）
• 毁灭 1
• 致命 5+
• 关键穿刺 1
• 集中
• 严重
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION RULE
SPECIAL ISSUE AMMUNITION
The Deathwatch utilise a range of specialised
ammunition in many of their weapons. Each type is
designed to eliminate specific xenos foes.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative is performing the
Shoot action, in the Select Weapon step, you
can use this rule. If you do, select one of the
following weapon rules for that operative’s ranged
weapons to have until the end of the action. This
rule cannot be used with explosive grenades (see
universal equipment) or melta bombs.
• Blast 1" (you cannot select this if the weapon
profile being used has the Torrent weapon rule)
• Devastating 1
• Lethal 5+
• Piercing Crits 1
• Saturate
• Severe

cards.text:
死亡守望
标识/指示物指南
弹药储备指示物指间武器指示物
监察伺服机仆指示物机警神射手指示物
先进全相干扰器指示物热熔炸弹指示物
战略指挥战略计谋战略指挥交战计谋
指示物指示物
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Ammunition Reserve
Digital Weapons token
token
Scrutavore Servo-Thrall Vigilant Marksman
token token
Advanced
Melta Bomb token
Omni-Scrambler token
Strategic Command Strategic Command
Strategy Ploy token Firefight Ploy token

cards.text:
死亡守望
战略计谋
任务战术
通过收集到的战略资料以及艰险战斗累积的经
验，死亡守望掌握了能够应对几乎所有敌人
的战术。
选择隐匿或交战。每当一名己方死亡守望特工
对拥有那个命令的敌方特工进行射击、近战或反
击时，那名己方特工获得“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
STRATEGY PLOY
MISSION TACTICS
Through collated strategic data and hard-won combat
experience, the Deathwatch possess the tactics to
combat almost any foe.
Select Conceal or Engage. Whenever a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative is shooting against,
fighting against, or retaliating against an enemy
operative that has that order, that friendly
operative’s weapons have the Balanced
weapon rule.

cards.text:
死亡守望
战略计谋
漫长警戒
死亡守望守护着帝国一部分最为危险的区域。
他们立誓挺身警戒，见证着敌人在落荒逃跑前
迎来死亡。
每当一名特工对完全位于己方领地内的一名己方
死亡守望特工进行射击时，您可以重掷一枚己
方防御骰子。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
STRATEGY PLOY
THE LONG VIGIL
The Deathwatch guard some of the most dangerous
stretches of the Imperium. Their vow to stand firm is
at the heart of their vigil; they will see their foes dead
before they abandon the Emperor’s realm.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative that’s wholly within
your territory, you can re-roll one of your
defence dice.

cards.text:
死亡守望
战略计谋
戮敌坚盾
进入异形肆虐的巢穴意味着要面对极度非人的
憎物和科技，死亡守望在面对这些恶毒之物时
已做好了万全准备。
每当一名己方死亡守望特工完全位于您对手的
领地内，它在受到伤害为 4 点或更多的普通伤害
时，受到的伤害降低 1 点。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
STRATEGY PLOY
THE SHIELD THAT SLAYS
To enter the infested holds of the xenos is to be assailed
by the most inhuman of abominations and technology, a
foulness that the Deathwatch are trained to resist.
Whenever a friendly DEATHWATCH operative is
wholly within your opponent’s territory, Normal
Dmg of 4 or more inflicts 1 less damage on it.

cards.title_en: AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
cards.text:
死亡守望
战略计谋
他们无所畏惧
星际战士拥有超凡的勇气和坚定的意志，就算
是面对究极的恐惧之物或者看似不可能克服的
绝境时也绝不会动摇。
您可以忽略任何己方死亡守望特工因受创而导
致的属性变化（包括武器属性）。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
STRATEGY PLOY
AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
Space Marines possess extraordinary courage and are
utterly unflinching in the face of terrifying horrors and
overwhelming odds.
You can ignore any changes to the stats of
friendly DEATHWATCH operatives from being
injured (including their weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
死亡守望
交战计谋
异形，绝不宽恕
死亡守望会利用一切可用之物，一切学识对抗
异形。他们对异形的仇恨就如同磨刀石，磨砺
着他们的每一件武器。
在一名己方死亡守望特工掷攻击骰子时，且作
为射击目标，近战目标或反击目标的特工没有混
沌或帝国关键词时使用本交战计谋。您可以重掷
任意己方的攻击骰子。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SUFFER NOT THE ALIEN
Every tool at their disposal, every scrap of knowledge,
is sharpened upon the whetstone of the Deathwatch’s
hatred of the alien.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly DEATHWATCH operative, if it’s
shooting against, fighting against, or retaliating
against an operative that doesn’t have the CHAOS
or IMPERIUM keyword. You can re-roll any of your
attack dice.

cards.text:
死亡守望
交战计谋
占卜仪追踪
占卜仪通过与战斗兄弟神经连接后能够大大增
强其感官，几乎能达到未卜先知的水平。
在一名己方死亡守望特工进行反击，且尚未执
行任何行动时使用本交战计谋。您可以更改其
命令。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
AUSPICATOR TRACKING
Neurally connected to a battle-brother’s senses,
auspicator lenses can improve their data prescience to
almost precognitive levels.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative is counteracting,
before it performs any actions. You can change
its order.

cards.text:
死亡守望
交战计谋
先进鸟卜扫描
通过生物手环以及内藏鸟卜仪的持续扫描，死
亡守望能获得潜在威胁的警告，同时他们也能
通过强化的直觉识别出潜藏的敌人。
在一名己方死亡守望特工执行射击行动时使用
本交战计谋。直到这次激活/反应结束前，它的
远程武器获得“集中”武器规则且敌方特工不能
被遮挡。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ADVANCED AUSPEX SCAN
Between unstinting sweeps of their bioscryer cuffs,
their inbuilt auspexes warning of hostile threats and the
augmented instincts of the Deathwatch themselves, no
lurking threat can long evade their sights.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative performs the
Shoot action. Until the end of the activation/
counteraction, its ranged weapons have the
Saturate weapon rule and enemy operatives
cannot be obscured.

cards.text:
死亡守望
交战计谋
超人体格
受到基因改造的星际战士能够承受那些足够将
凡人杀死的伤势。
在一名特工对一名己方死亡守望特工进行射击
时，您可以在掷防御骰步骤中使用本交战计谋。
您可以将一次普通成功作为关键成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
The genetically modified physiology of a Space
Marine is capable of resisting wounds that would kill a
lesser being.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly DEATHWATCH operative,
in the Roll Defence Dice step. You can retain
one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营装备
指间武器
各种高功率激光，毒针，焚烧器等都能隐藏于
仿生植入物和臂甲中。尽管这类装置在远距离
上几无效果，但在近距离使用时足以在敌人抵
挡主要攻击时打击他的弱点。
每个转折点限一次，每当一名己方死亡守望特
工执行近战行动时，在掷攻击骰子步骤开始时，
您便可以使用这个规则。若此，在那次流程中那
名敌方战士受到 1 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DIGITAL WEAPONS
Various high-powered lasers, toxic needlers, incineration
projectors and more are concealed as bionic implants or
in the knuckles of gauntlets. They lack the power to be
used at range, but can be triggered up close to exploit a
weakness while the enemy fends off the main attack.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative performs the Fight
action, at the start of the Roll Attack Dice step,
you can use this rule. If you do, inflict 1 damage
on the enemy operative in that sequence.

cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营装备
监察伺服机仆
这种特制的伺服颅骨通过反重力装置盘旋在杀
戮小队的部署区域，贪婪地收集数据进行分析
后将结果传给各位战斗兄弟以提供强大的战
略参考。这些装置大多由忠仆的颅骨制造而
成，还有一部分则是由经过圣化的战败异形头
颅制成。
每个转折点一次，在一名己方死亡守望特工激
活时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，在那次激活
中，那名特工可以在执行一次任务行动时将消耗
的 AP 减少 1 点。
那名己方特工的控制范围内存在敌方特工也不会
阻止它执行那次任务行动。不过，在这种情况
下，在执行任务行动后，您需要与您的对手拼
骰。若您的对手获胜，则您在本场战斗中不能再
次使用这个装备。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SCRUTAVORE SERVO-THRALL
This specialised servo-skull circles a kill team’s
deployment on anti-grav motors, consuming data at
a voracious rate before dissecting it and feeding the
resultant analyses to the battle-brothers to provide
maximum strategic awareness. Many are built upon
the skulls of loyal serfs, though some are constructed
around the sanctified craniums of defeated xenos.
Once per turning point, during a friendly
DEATHWATCH operative’s activation, you can
use this rule. If you do, during that activation,
that operative can perform a mission action for 1
less AP.
Having an enemy operative within its control
range doesn’t prevent that friendly operative
from performing that mission action. However,
in such an instance, after it does so, you and
your opponent roll-off. If your opponent wins,
you cannot use this equipment for the rest of
the battle.

cards.title_zh: 圣图斯-V型生物监测手环
cards.image: 40-03-阵营装备-圣图斯-V型生物监测手环.png
cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营装备
圣图斯-V 型生物监测手环
在卡斯提洛·努利法特守望要塞的技术军士和
药剂师共同开发下，这种腕甲内的监控设备通
过提供生理分析给予了使用者无与伦比的分析
和净化生化威胁的能力。
每当一名己方死亡守望特工激活时，在其执行
一次行动之前或之后，若其不位于敌方特工的控
制范围内，您可以使用一次这个规则。若此，选
择下列选项之一：
• 那名己方特工恢复最多 D3 点失去的耐伤。
• 移除对那名己方特工 APL 属性的任意修正。
• 移除那名己方特工拥有的一枚下列指示物（在
那枚指示物的激活效果被结算前，如果有）：
中子碎片，毒害，恐惧试剂。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SANCTUS-V BIOSCRYER CUFFS
Developed by Techmarines and Apothecaries of the
Castilos Nullifact watch fortress, these vambrace-
mounted monitron relays offer unparalleled analysis
and purgation of a range of bio-threats to the wearer’s
augmented physiology.
Once during each friendly DEATHWATCH
operative’s activation, before or after it performs
an action, if it’s not within control range of enemy
operatives, you can use this rule. If you do, select
one of the following:
• That friendly operative regains up to D3
lost wounds.
• Remove any changes to that friendly
operative’s APL stat.
• Remove one of the following tokens that
friendly operative has (before that token’s
activation effects are resolved, if relevant):
Neutron Fragment, Poison, Terrorchem.

cards.text:
死亡守望
阵营装备
弹药储备
这些致命精准的杀戮小队被赋予了额外的特制
弹药、燃料储罐以及弹药电池，以保障在最危
险任务中取得胜利。
每场战斗限一次，您可以在一个转折点中为两次
射击行动使用特制弹药规则，但在这两次使用规
则中您必须选择不同的武器规则。本规则优先于
特制弹药规则。
cards.text_en:
DEATHWATCH
FACTION EQUIPMENT
AMMUNITION RESERVE
Awarded to kill teams whose marksmanship is as
efficient as it is lethal, additional caches of individually
crafted shells, fuel canisters and ammunition cells serve
to secure victory during the most dangerous missions.
Once per battle, you can use the Special Issue
Ammunition faction rule for up to two Shoot
actions during one turning point, but you must
select different weapon rules for both uses. This
takes precedence over the normal Special Issue
Ammunition rules.
